description: Return a bounded slice of a named log source on this host: the last N lines, or the lines of the last time span (at most N), as one JSON document {host, name, kind, target, lines, count, truncated, since, duration_ms}, or as plain lines with text. The caller names a configured source and the window only; which journal unit or file a name reads, and any filter, is fixed in this host's /etc/log-review/sources.conf, so no path, unit or search string is accepted. At most 1000 lines (100 when not given) and 7 days (the agent may lower both). Exit 0 ok, 1 the source cannot be read, 2 caller error, 3 config error. Makes no changes. list shows the configured sources and whether each can be read; check_config parses a config file and runs nothing.

name.description: Name of the source, as configured on the agent (see list).

lines.description: How many lines: the last N, or with since the newest N of the window. Default 100 unless the agent sets another.

since.description: Only lines of the last span: a whole number and one of s, m, h, d, such as 90m or 2d. At most 7d (the agent may lower it).

text.description: Plain lines instead of JSON (with name only).

list.description: List the sources this host offers: name, kind (journal or file), target, whether it can be read (and why not), whether a filter applies.

check_config.description: Path of a config file, in the config's own folder, to parse with the same rules as the real one, running nothing: returns its sources and settings; exit 0 if it parses, 3 with an error naming the line if not. Used as the validate command when the config is deployed.
